verdict.rationale: Claude Code's documented CLAUDE.md file is read automatically at the start of every session, which gives persistent cross-session recall of project context. The evidence describes it as a file the developer adds and maintains, not memory the agent builds itself. Missing for 10: evidence the agent automatically creates or updates memory from sessions, documentation of any auto-memory feature, independent hands-on corroboration of cross-session recall.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent build and recall memory automatically across sessions

citations.quote: CLAUDE.md is a markdown file you add to your project root that Claude Code reads at the start of every session.
Use it to set coding standards, architecture decisions, preferred libraries, and review checklists.
